name: fit-circle
why: A circle of radius 20 sampled at 200 points and fitted closed at 0.01 mm, extruded 10: the analytic disc is pi*400*10 = 12566.371 mm3, and a curve held within 0.01 mm of a 125.66 mm perimeter can move it by at most 12.6 mm3. deviation_mm is the kernel's own measurement of the built curve against the samples, read back from the part, and must sit under the tolerance asked; the fit is 19 poles of degree 3 on uniform knots, where the same outline as bspline control points was 200.
